definition: The management of when each participant (user or AI system) should speak or respond during a conversation.
details: Turn-taking is a practical engineering concern in real-time conversational AI systems, particularly for voice interfaces, where the system must decide when a user has finished speaking and it is appropriate to respond.
story: Imagine explaining a hard concept to a friend using nothing but a napkin and a pen. Think of it this way: The management of when each participant (user or AI system) should speak or respond during a conversation. And here is the clever part: Turn-taking is a practical engineering concern in real-time conversational AI systems, particularly for voice interfaces, where the system must decide when a user has finished speaking and it is appropriate to respond. A small mental model that makes a big tangle suddenly simple. That is Turn-Taking (in dialogue systems) — a small key that opens a big door.
